run_tcp_connect: run the script to open a TCP connection to a specified server host and port
run_tcp_connect_with_timeout: run the script with a custom timeout to connect to a server within seconds
test_tcp_connectivity: test TCP connectivity to a server by running the script with host and port flags
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args and opens a TCP handshake to a server
summarize_tcp_connect: summarize the tcp_connect script that opens a TCP connection to a specified server and exits
